overview: A framework for makers to define named, reusable rendering recipes (subtypes) for SharePoint columns, plus a built-in seed catalog. Subtypes carry value->text transforms, visual styling, and fx-bar vocabulary; may expose typed apply-time knobs. v1 also rewires the fx bar to read subtype vocab, fixing the original suggestion-noise complaint.

in: Seed catalog: existing columnPresets re-expressed + Money seed
Snapshot apply (bake knobs, tag column) as one undoable mutation
Push-update: re-bake all tagged columns as one batched undoable mutation
Full parameter editor (extracted-literals checklist -> typed knobs)
Save-as birth from a column's current formatter
fx-bar rewiring (strict vocab) with empty-vocab fallback
Catalog UI in the 'Format this column' menu; refine inline modal

Subtype.name: string (free display label; dotted name cosmetic)

storage.notes: Custom subtypes only; seeds live in code. try/catch private-mode safe. wb- prefix + existing keys frozen; wb-subtypes is a new key.
